📰✨ A Legacy That Began with a Dosa! ✨

Every iconic story begins with a humble dream. ❤️

Since 1965, Hotel Sunny Point has been serving Bhadrawati  with love, tradition, and unforgettable flavours. And in 1995, we began our South Indian journey, becoming one of the first to introduce dosa to the town! 🥞🌴

From our humble beginnings to the memories we create today, our story continues to be written with every plate we serve.

Sunny Point — Same Flavours. New Stories. Timeless Memories. 🤎

Some flavours are more than just food; they are a part of tradition. ❤️

Introducing Pesarattu Dosa, a wholesome Andhra-style classic made with protein-rich green gram, bringing together simple ingredients and authentic South Indian flavours.

After our much-loved Masala Dosa, Pesarattu became another special addition to the Sunny Point journey, bringing a new taste to Bhadravati.

Simple Ingredients. Timeless Flavours. Same Love. 🌿

Visit Hotel Sunny Point and savour the taste of tradition!

#restaurante #viralpost #HotelSunnyPoint #SouthIndianFood #BhadrawatiFood

Some flavours are more than just food — they’re memories passed down through generations. ❤️🥹

Since 1995, Sunny Point’s iconic Masala Dosa has brought families together with its crispy golden texture, flavourful potato masala, fresh coconut chutney, delicious sambhar, and a cup of hot coffee. ☕

The children who once came here for their favourite dosa now return with their own little ones, sharing the same taste, the same memories, and the same love. ❤️

Hotel Sunny Point, Bhadravati — Timeless Flavours.

 Same Love. ✨
